scientific_integrity: Existing construction, central symmetry, and triangulations are credited to Sanyal and Stump; no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotics require both level proportions to converge to values in (0,1). No conclusion for arbitrary posets. Related indexed summaries without available full text leave bibliographic uncertainty. Finite symbolic tests cannot prove asymptotic results.
title: Exact inertia spectrum and two-scale limits for two-level Lipschitz poset polytopes
